name: Rfam Viral RNA Families
title: Rfam viral RNA families: a curated collection of viral non-coding RNA structure families
description: Curated Rfam project providing covariance models and structure annotations for conserved viral RNA elements, including complete Coronaviridae, Hepacivirus, and Flaviviridae 5'/3' UTR family sets generated with R2DT, with Filoviridae and Rhabdoviridae families in progress.
